name: inspira-input
blurb: Input field with a spotlight radial glow that follows mouse movement.
description: An input field with a container div that renders a radial gradient spotlight centered at the cursor, tracking mouse movement with useState and applying a smooth background transition.
use_when: Creating interactive forms where cursor-tracking effects enhance visual engagement and interactivity feedback.
avoid_when: On touch interfaces or when motion should be absent.
a11y: Standard input accessibility applies; the spotlight effect is purely visual and non-interfering.
